settings.name: Taskbar style
settings.description: Which taskbar Explorer draws. Windows 10 (ExplorerPatcher) is ExplorerPatcher's own build of the Windows 10 taskbar, and the other taskbar rows here apply to it.

settings.name: Start button style
settings.description: The Start button drawn on the Windows 10 taskbar.

settings.name: Primary taskbar alignment
settings.description: Where the buttons sit on the main taskbar: at the edge like Windows 10, or centered like Windows 11.

options.name: Centered, at screen edge when full
Centered with Start button, at screen edge when full

settings.name: Secondary taskbar(s) alignment
settings.description: Where the buttons sit on the taskbars of other monitors.

options.name: Centered, at screen edge when full
Centered with Start button, at screen edge when full

settings.name: Combine taskbar icons on secondary taskbar(s)
settings.description: When windows of the same app share one button on the taskbars of other monitors.

settings.name: Taskbar icon size
settings.description: Small icons make the Windows 10 taskbar shorter.

settings.name: Win+C opens the clock flyout
settings.description: Pressing Win+C opens the clock and calendar instead of Microsoft Teams chat.

settings.name: Show separators between taskbar toolbars
settings.description: Draw a separator line between toolbars on the taskbar.

settings.name: Double-click the taskbar to toggle auto-hide
settings.description: Double-clicking an empty part of the taskbar turns auto-hide on or off. Works only while the taskbar is locked.

settings.name: Pinned items act as quick launch
settings.description: A pinned button always starts a new window instead of switching to the app's open windows, and running apps get their own button.

settings.name: Remove the extra gap around pinned items with labels
settings.description: When taskbar buttons show labels, a pinned item takes no more room than its icon.

settings.name: Skin taskbar and tray pop-up menus
settings.description: Draw the right-click menus of the taskbar and tray icons in the Windows 11 style instead of the classic look.

settings.name: Center tray icon pop-up menus
settings.description: Open a tray icon's menu centered above the icon instead of at the pointer.

settings.name: Open tray icon menus as flyouts
settings.description: Show tray icon menus in the Windows 11 flyout style. Off uses the classic pop-up menu.

settings.name: Show touch keyboard button
settings.description: Show the touch keyboard button in the tray.

settings.name: Show Quick Settings button
settings.description: Show the Windows 11 button in the tray that groups network, sound, and battery and opens Quick Settings.

settings.name: Show desktop button
settings.description: The thin button at the end of the taskbar that shows the desktop. Hidden removes it; Disabled keeps the space but does nothing.

settings.name: Show desktop button
settings.description: The thin button at the end of the taskbar that shows the desktop. Hidden removes it; Disabled keeps the space but does nothing.

settings.name: Apply Windows 11 style to system tray icons
settings.description: Draw the network, sound, and battery icons in the Windows 11 style on the Windows 10 taskbar.

settings.name: Hidden icons popup style
settings.description: The look of the pop-up that opens from the hidden icons arrow.

settings.name: Network icon right-click opens
settings.description: What "Open Network & Internet settings" in the network icon's right-click menu opens.

options.name: Network section in the Settings app (default)
Network and Sharing Center in Control Panel

settings.name: Network icon opens
settings.description: The panel that opens when you click the network icon in the tray.

options.name: Network section in the Settings app
Network and Sharing Center in Control Panel

settings.name: Sound icon opens
settings.description: The volume panel that opens when you click the sound icon in the tray.

settings.name: Clock opens
settings.description: The calendar panel that opens when you click the clock.

settings.name: Battery icon opens
settings.description: The panel that opens when you click the battery icon.

settings.name: Language switcher style
settings.description: The look of the keyboard language switcher in the tray.

settings.name: Language switcher style
settings.description: The look of the keyboard language switcher in the tray.

settings.name: Layout
settings.description: What the widget shows: icon, description, temperature.

settings.name: Widget size
settings.description: Whether the widget grows with its text or keeps one fixed width.

settings.name: Widget position
settings.description: Which end of the taskbar the widget sits at.

settings.name: Update frequency
settings.description: How often the widget fetches new weather.

settings.name: Temperature unit
settings.description: Celsius or Fahrenheit.

settings.name: Color scheme
settings.description: Light or dark widget, or follow the Windows setting.

settings.name: Corner style
settings.description: How rounded the weather pop-up's corners are.

settings.name: Icon pack
settings.description: Whose weather icons the widget uses.

settings.name: Contents layout
settings.description: One line, or two lines when the taskbar is tall enough.

settings.name: Zoom
settings.description: Scale of the widget's contents.

settings.name: Use immersive style for Windows 10 context menus
settings.description: Draw Windows 10 style right-click menus with the larger touch-friendly look. Off uses the compact classic menu. New windows only.

settings.name: Always use legacy file transfer dialog
settings.description: Copy and move files with the Windows 7 progress dialog instead of the newer one with the speed graph.

settings.name: Use classic drive groupings in This PC
settings.description: Group drives in This PC the Windows 7 way (hard disks, removable drives, network locations) instead of one Devices and drives list.

settings.name: Title bar shows
settings.description: Whether File Explorer windows show the folder icon and name in the title bar. New windows only.

settings.name: Hide search bar completely
settings.description: Remove the search box from File Explorer windows. New windows only.

settings.name: Shrink address bar height
settings.description: Make the address bar in File Explorer windows shorter. New windows only.

settings.name: Mica effect on the Windows 7 navigation bar
settings.description: Tint the navigation bar of File Explorer windows with the Mica effect when the Windows 7 command bar is in use. New windows only.

settings.name: Start menu style
settings.description: Windows 10 opens the Windows 10 Start menu, which needs its code to still be present in this Windows build.

settings.name: Open Start on this monitor (keyboard)
settings.description: With more than one display, which monitor the Start menu opens on when you press the Windows key.

settings.name: Open Start in All apps by default
settings.description: Open the Windows 11 Start menu on the All apps list instead of Pinned.

settings.name: Disable quadrant snapping
settings.description: Dragging a window to a corner snaps it to half the screen, not a quarter.

settings.name: Snap Assist style
settings.description: Which Snap Assist appears after you snap a window.

settings.name: Alt+F4 on the desktop defaults to
settings.description: The action preselected in the Shut Down Windows dialog that Alt+F4 opens on the desktop.

settings.name: Show Windows build info on the desktop
settings.description: Print the Windows edition and build number in the corner of the desktop.

settings.name: Window switcher (Alt+Tab) style
settings.description: Which window switcher Alt+Tab opens. Simple Window Switcher is ExplorerPatcher's own, and the rows below apply to it.

settings.name: Show the desktop as the last window
settings.description: Add the desktop at the end of the Alt+Tab list so you can switch to it.

settings.name: Always display switcher on primary monitor
settings.description: Open the switcher on the main monitor even when the pointer is on another one.

settings.name: Show only windows on the monitor with the pointer
settings.description: List only the windows on the monitor the pointer is on.

settings.name: Group windows of the same app
settings.description: Show one entry per app, with its windows listed under it.

settings.name: Theme
settings.description: The switcher's background. Acrylic blurs what is behind it; Mica is a solid tinted surface.

settings.name: Background opacity
settings.description: How solid the switcher's background is.

settings.name: Color scheme
settings.description: Light or dark switcher, or follow the Windows setting.

settings.name: Corner style
settings.description: How rounded the switcher window's corners are.

settings.name: Row height
settings.description: Height of each row of window previews.

settings.name: Maximum width
settings.description: The widest the switcher grows, as a share of the screen width.

settings.name: Maximum height
settings.description: The tallest the switcher grows, as a share of the screen height.

settings.name: Window padding
settings.description: Space between the switcher's edge and its contents.

settings.name: Show delay
settings.description: How long Alt+Tab is held before the switcher appears. A short delay lets a quick Alt+Tab switch without drawing it.

settings.name: Scroll wheel changes selection
settings.description: Whether the mouse wheel moves the selection while the switcher is open.

options.name: When cursor is over the switcher

settings.name: Hide the "Learn about this picture" icon
settings.description: Remove the "Learn about this picture" icon Spotlight places on the desktop.

settings.name: Spotlight items in the desktop menu
settings.description: Which Spotlight commands appear in the desktop's right-click menu.

options.name: Learn about and switch to next picture
Info and switch to next picture
Info, copyright, and switch to next picture
Info, learn about, and switch to next picture
Info, copyright, learn about, and switch to next picture

settings.name: Update frequency
settings.description: How often Spotlight fetches a new desktop picture.

options.name: Let Windows decide the best schedule (default)

settings.name: Disable Win+F (Feedback Hub) hotkey
settings.description: Stop Win+F from opening the Feedback Hub.

settings.name: Disable Office hotkeys
settings.description: Stop the Ctrl+Alt+Shift+Windows key shortcuts from opening Office apps.

settings.name: Enable logon, logoff, and shutdown sounds
settings.description: Play the Windows 7 sign-in, sign-out, and shutdown sounds.

settings.name: Keep System / About in Control Panel
settings.description: Open the classic Control Panel page instead of the Settings app when this link is used.

settings.name: Keep Programs and Features in Control Panel
settings.description: Open the classic Control Panel page instead of the Settings app when this link is used.

settings.name: Keep Adjust date/time in Control Panel
settings.description: Open the classic Control Panel page instead of the Settings app when this link is used.

settings.name: Keep Customize notification icons in Control Panel
settings.description: Open the classic Control Panel page instead of the Settings app when this link is used.

settings.name: Check for updates
settings.description: What ExplorerPatcher's own updater does when File Explorer starts. Do not check keeps the installed version, which is the one these rows were written for.

settings.name: Fix rendering under the classic theme
settings.description: Extra patches so the taskbar, tray, and folder views draw correctly when the Windows classic theme is forced on.

settings.name: Play UI sounds in Explorer's XAML views
settings.description: Enable the click and navigation sounds in the parts of Explorer built with XAML, such as the Start menu and taskbar flyouts.
